name: code-vide
description: Vscode extension that mimics the behavior of the Bionic Reading API. Inspired by TextVide.

codeVide.sep.description: Separator to use before and after the bold part. Can be a single string or an array of [prefix, suffix].

codeVide.fixationPoint.description: Controls how much of each word is bold. Level 1 bolds larger chunks (best for quick reading), while Level 5 uses minimal bolding (best for careful reading).

codeVide.extraContrast.description: Whether to set the later half of text to thin for extra contrast.

codeVide.debounceDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before updating the text decorations after changes. Do not change this value unless you know what you are doing.

codeVide.currentLineOnly.description: Only apply decorations to the current cursor line.

scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
